title: Background processes phase 2: define and edit rules in conversation (router + Jev compilation) and the general rule engine
body:
Part of #10155. Spec: [docs/background/2026-10-02-background-processes.md](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/background/2026-10-02-background-processes.md), sections "What a background process is" and "Phase 2". Builds on #10156.

## Goal

A user defines or changes a background process in conversation ("keep my disk above 50 GB free; clear old build caches first", "only keep 2 agent target dirs", "never touch ~/.openagents/pylon", "pause disk cleanup until tomorrow"), and gets a typed, inspectable rule that the host then runs deterministically. The conversation compiles the rule once; it is never re-interpreted at run time.

## Work

- **Routing (`crates/coder` router).** Add `background.define` and `background.edit` routes to the next chat-router question set, chosen by Jev like every other route. No keyword or string matching anywhere in route, action, or class selection (AGENTS.md).
- **Compiler (`crates/background`).** Ask Jev Choice questions over typed catalogs: trigger kinds, condition kinds, action kinds, candidate classes, and (for an edit) the existing rules and their fields. Fill bounded fields (sizes, percentages, durations, paths, times) with deterministic parsing only after the route is chosen. A named `Setting` `background.compile` (in the style of `crates/coder-delegate/src/decision.rs`): below it, ask one clarifying question instead of guessing.
- **General engine.** Every trigger (`Interval`, `Daily` with missed-run catch-up, `Threshold`, `TaskEnded`, `HostStart`, `FsEvent` via FSEvents/inotify), every condition including `Judgment` (a Jev question set + `Setting`), multiple rules, per-rule cooldown and jitter.
- **Confirmation card.** Terminal and CLI show the compiled rule (or the diff for an edit) and its dry run now, with confirm and cancel. A rule is never applied silently. Record `origin: Conversation { thread, message }`.
- **CLI.** `openagents background add` accepts a message as well as a file.

## Tests

- A labeled request set in `crates/gym/questions/` (define, edit, pause, off-topic) scored like the router evaluation.
- Golden compiled rules for the examples in the spec.
- A request below `background.compile` produces a question, not a rule.
- Engine tests for each trigger and condition with an injected clock and injected file events.

Size: medium to large. Checks: `cargo test -p` for the touched crates and `cargo fmt`.
